BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to health insurance policies; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The office of the insurance commissionershall contract for an independent health care actuarial review of allexisting health care coverage statutory requirements. The statutoryrequirements to be reviewed shall be those listed in "Mandated Benefitsin Washington State," policy division, Washington state office of theinsurance commissioner, January 10, 2002. The review shall determinethe cost of including the statutory requirements in a health plan,including the premium cost per member per month; an assessment of thecostbenefit ratio of the statutory requirement and whether thestatutory requirement can be correlated to savings in other services;and an assessment of whether market demand has already resulted ininclusion of current statutory requirements in a significant number ofhealth benefit plans in states that do not have such statutoryrequirements. There shall be an interim report to appropriate p. 1 SHB 1685committees of the legislature on December 1, 2005, and a final reportsubmitted by December 1, 2006.
